validated_results.title: Dynamic Soluble IL-6R/Soluble gp130 Ratio as a Potential Indicator for the Prostate Malignancy Phenotype-A Multicenter Case-Control Study.
validated_results.reason: This case-control study compares serum inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers (including total antioxidant status) between prostate cancer and BPH patients as malignancy-phenotype indicators, providing no evidence on nutritional antioxidant exposure and risk of developing prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: To Drink or Not to Drink? Investigating Alcohol's Impact on Prostate Cancer Risk.
validated_results.reason: The article is explicitly a literature review of epidemiological studies and meta-analyses on alcohol and prostate cancer risk rather than an original human study.

validated_results.title: Epigenetic DNA modifications and vitamin C in prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia: Exploring similarities, disparities, and pathogenic implications.
validated_results.reason: Vitamin C was quantified in plasma, leukocytes and prostate tissues of existing prostate cancer and BPH patients to explore epigenetic pathogenic mechanisms and potential early markers, without any estimate of prostate cancer incidence.
